sanitization_strategy: Remove task-specific material rather than attempting cosmetic anonymization; replace the worked example with a deterministic synthetic benchmark.
removed_from_original_full_package: The user-supplied reference image and its complete-reference page asset
All task-derived local crops, rendered preview, VSDX fixture, shape inventory, validation data, and quality metrics
The exact task-specific reconstruction script and task-specific labels or coordinates
License wording tied to a particular user or internal-only source asset
The example PDF carrying a build creation timestamp
Stale package manifest entries and build-local paths

replacement_assets.input_source: No external or user-provided reference. Reference, 12 abstract frames, scene JSON, and VSDX are generated by the bundled script.

scan_scope: Markdown, text, JSON, Python, XML, relationship, SVG, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript content
Explicit deny terms for the prior personalized case

manual_review.result: No private name, institution, email, chat/file identifier, local path, real photograph, user-supplied source image, or task-specific worked example retained. Repository URLs contain only the public maintainer handle.

limitations: Pattern scanning cannot mathematically prove anonymity.
Future users must repeat the scan after adding their own examples or logs.
A renamed or lightly edited private image is not anonymous and must not be distributed as a synthetic example.
